from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EmployeeBenefitsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Employee Benefits Payable amount reported in one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The Employee Benefits Payable amount, in yuan")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    employee_benefits_payables: list[EmployeeBenefitsPayable]
